description: The profiles a config names in `profile`: each is a description and its risk rules, which replace the built-in rules with the same selector (schemas/risks.json). A config's own `risks.rules` replace a profile's the same way. A profile has no other setting, so the risk rules alone say when an agent asks for Spec approval. With no config, the solo profile applies.

solo.description: One person directs the agents and decides. The agent writes a Spec for a normal or major change, asks for Spec approval on major only, and asks before anything reaches the default branch.

rules.reason: on a normal change the agent writes the Spec, says so, and goes on

team.description: One or a few teams on one repository. The agent asks for Spec approval on normal and major changes, and a person merges through the platform's review: the agent opens the PR/MR and stops there.
